left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Male  [OR] or female > 18  [AND] and < 60 years of age, Body Mass Index (BMI) <40

right.raw_text:
-  Generally in good health as determined by the Principal Investigator based on prior medical history, American Society of Anesthesiologists physical status I or II
  -  Normal blood pressure (systolic 90-140 mmHg; diastolic 50-90 mmHg) resting heart rate
     45-100 beats per minute) without medication
  -  Female subjects of child-bearing potential  [AND] and those < 1 year post-menopausal, must be practicing highly effective methods of birth control such as hormonal methods
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Hypersensitivity, allergy, [OR]  or significant reaction to any ingredient of Pitocin®
  -  Any disease, [OR]  diagnosis, [OR]  or condition (medical  [OR] or surgical) that, in the opinion of the Principal Investigator, would place the subject at increased risk (active gynecologic disease in which increased tone would be detrimental e

, uterine fibroids  [AND] with ongoing bleeding), compromise the subject's compliance with study procedures, or compromise the quality of the data
  -  Women  [AND] who are pregnant (positive result for serum pregnancy test at screening visit), women  [AND] who are currently nursing  [OR] or lactating, women  [AND] that have been pregnant within 2 years
  -  Subjects with neuropathy, chronic pain, [OR]  diabetes mellitus, [OR]  or taking benzodiazepines  [OR] or pain medications on a daily basis
